verdict.rationale: Rive is a design and animation editor, so exporting static production assets is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only documents exporting a single .riv file for its runtimes. Nothing shows PNG, SVG or PDF export, per-layer export presets, scale multipliers or slices, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As a designer, I can export production assets — PNG, SVG, PDF, and more — with per-layer presets, scales, and slices
